paraphrase: The rudrākṣa arose from Kālāgnirudra's tears after he closed his eyes to destroy Tripura; beads are of various sizes and colours and have one to fourteen faces, each with a presiding deity; wearing and consecrating them with mantras removes sins; sages such as Nidāgha, Jaḍabharata, Dattātreya and others wore them.

checks.note: E-text 1-10 located in the e-text; the passage matches the paraphrase.
